entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge cum Special Judge (POCSO), Tinsukia
entities.label: COURT

sentences._hearing_file: Wajid Hussain Alias Munna vs The State Of Assam And Anr on 30 March, 2026.json

sentences.text:
Mr. Kamar, learned Sr. counsel for the accused submits that as per his instruction, all the major witnesses have been examined here in this case and further, he submits that for the last 7 months,
the POCSO Court, in which the present case is pending for trial, is not functioning due to absence of Presiding Officer and therefore, the petitioner prefers the present application for granting regular bail.
Mr. Borthakur, learned Additional P.P., however, submits that at this stage, the scanned copy of the record may be called for from the learned Trial Court.
Accordingly, taking note of the submission of learned counsel for both the parties, it is provided that Registry shall call for the scanned copy of the record with up to date status report, fixing the matter on 07.04.2025.
In the meantime, the petitioner shall also take step for service of notice upon respondent No.2,
through the Registry of this Court.

sentences.text: Mr. Borthakur shall, after service of notice upon the respondent No.2, obtain a report from the jurisdictional P.S. Step be taken within 2(two) working days from today.
